text:
bella: quick thread — lightweight v2 exposure tonight. plan: opt-in header + tenant pin protection. window 23:00-02:00 UTC. start with header opt-in 5%.

tom: confirm enterprise tenants stay pinned to v1? we must avoid auto-upgrades.

bella: yes, tenant pins remain authoritative. header only for opt-in clients.

deploy-bot: scheduled deploy by bella at 23:00 UTC. cmd: `redwoodctl deploy --env=prod --route=/api/v2 --opt-in-header=x-api-version:v2 --sample=0.05`

qa: note: streaming payload line-break change — will keep streaming disabled for opt-in wave.

infra: added routing rule `optin_header_v2` with precedence below tenant_pin. TTL 6h.

bella: smoke run: 150 requests from EU/US using header. results: p95 +9ms, no 5xx.

tom: can we whitelist canary tenants for full-v2 opt-in? request canary-7 for deeper tests.

bella: canary-7 added, will be removed after 12h.

infra: alerts set: page if prod_5xx_rate delta >=0.5% over baseline for 5m.

deploy-bot: opt-in gate enabled at 23:05 UTC, optin-id=opt-4089

qa: internal regression pass on canary-7 passed. no semantic diffs on sample prompts.

bella: ramp to 25% at 00:30 UTC if stable. rollback if auth failures or 5xx spike. deploy-bot will auto-stop.

infra: observed minor CDN header lower-casing; added header-normalize check to runbook.

tom: reminder to update release notes and SDK teams about header name and tenant pin behavior.

bella: closing thread after ramp window. will open switch planning thread next week for streaming opt-in. thanks all :thumbsup:
